スコアを伸びる効果 (Score increasing effects): スキルの「上昇」効果が「スキルパワー」を上昇します。基本的に乗算です。上昇したスキルパワーが少数の第2位から捨て下がる計算方法もあります。浮動小数点数の計算が使われているため、最後のスキルパワーが稀に期待する値より0.1%少ない場合があります。
例 (Examples): 長瀬麻奈「You're my everything」のSPスキルがレベル3（1,140%）の場合、クリティカル率11段階で,1140% * (100% + 11段階 × 6.7%) = 1140% * 173.7% = 1,980.18%の効果が1,980.1%になります。

スコアを伸びる効果 (Score increasing effects): Skills with effect lines that can power up always do so by increasing their "Skill Power" parameter. The scaling is multiplicative with the original skill power. After applying the effect, round down the resulting skill power to the nearest 0.1%. The in-game computation is performed using floating-point arithmetic, so it is possible for the true final skill power to be 0.1% lower than the expected value.
例 (Examples): Consider "You're my everything" Mana Nagase's SP skill at level 3 (1,140% skill power). If she has 11 steps of Critical Rate UP, then the skill power is calculated to be 1,140% * (100% + 11 steps * 6.7%) = 1,140% * 173.7% = 1,980.18%. The second decimal place is discarded, so the final result is truncated to 1,980.1%.
